edits.content:
version: 2
models:
- name: fct_world_productivity
  description: 'Metric 2, GTA V to GTA 6: world productivity per year from 2013 to 2026 and its real change
    since GTA V''s launch year. One row per measure per year.'
  config:
    meta:
      dex:
        grain:
        - world_productivity_key
        population:
          rule: Every year from var gta_v_year (2013) to var gta_6_year (2026) for both measures, published
            or not; an unpublished, unestimated year keeps its row with a NULL value.
        assumptions:
        - decision: Measures of productivity
          chosen: World Bank GDP per person employed and GDP per capita, world aggregate, real
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: productivity measured by actual economic indexes (GDP per capita) for the whole
            world, economic data only'
          column: measure
        - decision: Years covered
          chosen: 2013 to 2026, every year
          evidence: request
          detail: 'user: bookended by the GTA V and GTA 6 releases (17 Sep 2013, 19 Nov 2026)'
          column: data_year
        - decision: Years the World Bank has not published
          chosen: per capita carried by IMF WEO world real GDP growth less latest World Bank population
            growth, flagged is_estimate; per worker left NULL
          evidence: default
          detail: the IMF WEO is the standard published source for the current year; no free published
            world employment growth to carry output per worker
          column: value
  columns:
  - name: world_productivity_key
    description: md5 of measure|year.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: key
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: measure
    description: output_per_worker or output_per_person.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: data_year
    description: Calendar year the value describes.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: year_start
    description: '1 January of data_year: the time axis.'
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: time
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: launch
    description: GTA V on 2013, GTA 6 on 2026, NULL in between.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: dimension
  - name: value
    description: Real output in the measure's unit.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: 'NULL when unpublished and not estimated: unavailable, never zero.'
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: see unit column
  - name: unit
    description: The value's unit.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: source_indicator
    description: World Bank indicator code.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: is_estimate
    description: True when the value is carried by IMF growth, not published by the World Bank.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
          null_rule: never
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: is_latest
    description: True on the measure's latest year with a value.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: attribute
  - name: pct_change_since_gta_v
    description: Real change since GTA V's launch year, in percent.
    config:
      meta:
        dex:
          role: measure
          null_rule: NULL when the year's value is unavailable.
          aggregation: max
          additivity: non_additive
          unit: percent
unit_tests:
